headline: Chainalysis breach exposes all users' credentials; Zyxel GS1900 patch still bypassed; WordPress KEV deadline is today

bullets.text: New: Chainalysis disclosed a breach that exposed all users' credentials and forced it to shut down key services. SITCON holds at 3 (ELEVATED); the last 7 days scored 0.69x the 90-day average.
New: the UK warned that its critical infrastructure faces grave risk. Separately, FBI and CISA urged operators to harden refrigeration and cooling systems amid ongoing attacks.

Still active, Zyxel GS1900, 4 outlets: Zyxel's fix for a zero-day used to hack nearly 1,000 switches did not block the in-the-wild exploit (CVE-2026-107441), which allows root command execution. Top story on the board.

Due today, WordPress Core: CISA KEV lists CVE-2026-119977, a TOCTOU race condition exploited for RCE, federal due date 2026-11-06. Also in KEV: Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935 (due 2026-11-13) and Apple CVE-2024-27834 (due 2026-11-18).

Still active, supply chain: cPGuard autoupdate was hijacked in the OpsShield attack to serve malicious updates (4 outlets). The NIKKE PC game launcher was also hacked to spread remote-access and data-stealing malware.

Also on the board: OpenSSH emergency fix for long-password auth bypass on Alpine Linux; Barracuda critical root-access flaws; mSecure and DreamHost breaches; three charged over a $129 million AI CEO-impersonation scheme.

actions: Chainalysis users: reset passwords and rotate any API keys or credentials tied to the account; watch for related phishing.
Patch WordPress Core for CVE-2026-119977 today (KEV due 2026-11-06).
Treat Zyxel GS1900 switches as exposed even after patching: restrict management access, check for compromise, watch for a new fix.
cPGuard users: check servers for malicious updates and rotate credentials; NIKKE launcher users should scan for malware.
Apply the OpenSSH emergency fix on Alpine Linux hosts and Barracuda's fixes for the critical root-access flaws.
Operators of refrigeration and cooling systems: follow the FBI/CISA hardening guidance and remove internet exposure.
